high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from Brian Chesky's Twitter account (@bchesky), posted 7 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The tweet commemorates the launch of Airbnb on August 6, 2008, which is seventeen years ago as of the time the tweet was made. The tweet includes a screenshot of the original Airbnb website interface, showing a search for accommodations in San Francisco. The interface displays various listings with prices ranging from $10 to $99, along with small profile pictures next to each listing.

style_description.aesthetics: Digital screenshot, UI or software interface.
